post.summary: Validate user profile change and send verification code
post.description: Validates the user's current password and sends a verification code to the new email or phone number before allowing profile updates. This is a security measure to verify ownership of the new contact information.

type.description: Type of profile information to validate and update

country_code.description: Country code for phone number (required when type=phone)

mobile.description: New mobile phone number (required when type=phone)

status.description: Indicates if the request was successful

message.description: Success message indicating where the code was sent
message.example: Verification code has been successfully sent to your mobile number.

otp_id.description: ID of the verification record, needed for subsequent validation

items.example: The type field is required.
The password field is required.
The new email field is required when type is email.
The country code field is required when type is phone.
The mobile field is required when type is phone.

500.description: Internal server error (e.g., email sending failure)

post.summary: Update user profile information after verification
post.description: Updates the user's email or phone number after validating the verification code sent during the validate-profile step. This completes the secure profile update process.

type.description: Type of profile information being updated

confirmation_code.description: 6-digit verification code received via email or SMS

otp_id.description: ID of the OTP verification record from validate-profile response

country_code.description: Country code for new phone number (required when type=phone)

mobile.description: New mobile phone number (required when type=phone)

status.description: Indicates if the profile update was successful

400.description: Invalid verification code, expired, already used, or incorrect password

message.description: Error message indicating the specific issue

oneOf.example: The provided code is invalid, expired, or has already been used.
Incorrect password.

items.example: The type field is required.
The password field is required.
The confirmation code field is required.
The otp id field is required.
The new email field is required when type is email.
The country code field is required when type is phone.
The mobile field is required when type is phone.

post.summary: Change user password with current password verification
post.description: Allows an authenticated user to change their password by providing their current password and a new password. The new password must be at least 8 characters long and confirmed.

new_password_confirmation.description: Confirmation of the new password (must match new_password)

status.description: Indicates if the password change was successful

items.example: The current password field is required.

oneOf.example: The new password field is required.
The new password must be at least 8 characters.
The new password confirmation does not match.

items.example: The new password confirmation field is required.

post.summary: Enable or disable two-factor authentication for user
post.description: Allows an authenticated user to enable or disable two-factor authentication (2FA) for their account. This is a security feature that adds an extra layer of protection.

status.description: Indicates if the 2FA update was successful

401.description: User not found or not authenticated

oneOf.example: The enabled field is required.
The enabled field must be true or false.

post.summary: Share video journal with contacts and groups
post.description: Shares an existing video journal with selected contacts and/or contact groups. Creates new VideoRequest records with type 'share' and sends notifications via email and SMS to the recipients.

contact_ids.description: Array of contact IDs to share with

group_ids.description: Array of contact group IDs to share with

request_id.description: ID of the original video request to share

status.description: Indicates if the sharing was successful

message.example: Video shared successfully with your contacts.

oneOf.example: The request id field is required.
The selected request id is invalid.
The request id must be at least 1.
The contact_ids must be an array.
The selected contact_ids.0 is invalid.
The group_ids must be an array.
The selected group_ids.0 is invalid.

get.summary: Get contacts and groups for the authenticated user
get.description: Retrieves a paginated list of contacts and/or contact groups for the authenticated user. Supports filtering by type (contacts, groups, or all) and search functionality.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Search term to filter contacts/groups by name, email, or mobile

post.summary: Create a new contact
post.description: Creates a new contact for the authenticated user. Optionally assigns the contact to one or more groups. Prevents duplicate contacts with the same phone number.

country_code.description: Country code (defaults to '1' if not provided)

groups.description: Array of group IDs to assign this contact to

400.description: Contact with this phone number already exists or invalid group ID

oneOf.example: A contact with this phone number already exists.
Group ID 5 does not belong to the user.

items.example: The first name field is required.
The last name field is required.
The mobile field is required.
The email must be a valid email address.

get.summary: Get a specific contact by ID
get.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific contact, including associated groups. Only returns contacts that belong to the authenticated user.

404.description: Contact not found or does not belong to user

message.example: Contact not found or does not belong to the user.

put.description: Updates an existing contact's information and group associations. Only allows updating contacts that belong to the authenticated user.

groups.description: Array of group IDs to assign this contact to (replaces existing groups)

message.example: Group ID 5 does not belong to the user.

404.description: Contact not found or does not belong to user

message.example: Contact not found or does not belong to the user.

items.example: The first name field is required.
The email must be a valid email address.

delete.description: Permanently deletes a contact and removes it from all associated groups. Only allows deleting contacts that belong to the authenticated user.

404.description: Contact not found or does not belong to user

message.example: Contact not found or does not belong to the user.

post.summary: Create multiple contacts in batch
post.description: Creates multiple contacts in a single request for the authenticated user. Automatically detects and skips duplicate contacts based on phone number. Provides feedback on successful creations and duplicates.

country_code.description: Country code (defaults to '1' if not provided)

201.description: Contacts created successfully (may include duplicate information)

oneOf.example: Contacts created successfully.
Contacts created successfully. Some contacts already existed and were not added again.

created.description: Array of successfully created contact data

400.description: Missing required fields in one or more contacts

oneOf.example: The first_name field is required.
The last_name field is required.
The mobile field is required.

post.summary: Save and update video request with journal information
post.description: Updates an existing video request with journal title, tags, and privacy settings. Processes tags by category and handles tag creation if needed. This endpoint is used to finalize a video journal after recording.

request_id.description: ID of the video request to update

journal_tags.description: Array of tag IDs or tag names to associate with the journal

oneOf.description: New tag name to be created
oneOf.example: motivation

make_journal_private.description: Privacy setting: 0 for public, 1 for private

status.description: Indicates if the save operation was successful

request_id.description: ID of the updated video request (returned as string)

items.example: The request id field is required.

get.summary: Get emotional insights data for the authenticated user
get.description: Retrieves comprehensive emotional insights and analytics for the authenticated user based on their video journal submissions. Returns emotional parameters with current values, averages, time-based data, and progress tracking over various time periods.

lastMeasured.description: Date when emotions were last measured

404.description: User not found or no insights data available

get.summary: Get secondary/advanced emotional metrics for the authenticated user
get.description: Retrieves advanced emotional insights and secondary metrics for the authenticated user. Provides detailed analysis including self-honesty, stress recovery, cognitive balance, and anger metrics with enhanced status information and descriptions.

lastMeasured.description: Date when metrics were last measured

description.example: Measures your ability to be honest with yourself about your emotions and thoughts.

statusMessage.example: You're showing good self-awareness and emotional honesty.

statusType.description: Simplified status type for UI display

timelineData.description: Historical timeline data with same structure as emotions endpoint

404.description: User not found or no metrics data available

get.summary: Get credibility score insights for the authenticated user
get.description: Retrieves comprehensive credibility score data and analytics for the authenticated user across different video journal categories (Vijos). Returns current scores, averages, time-based data, and progress tracking over various periods with detailed metrics aggregation.

lastMeasured.description: Date when credibility scores were last measured

profile.description: Array of credibility score insights for different catalog types

range.description: Performance range classification based on standard deviation

dayChartData.description: Weekly credibility score data for chart visualization

timeChartData.description: Credibility score averages by time of day

all.description: All historical data since user started

404.description: User not found or no credibility score data available

post.summary: Start a new video request or retrieve existing request details
post.description: Initiates a video recording process by either creating a new video request or retrieving details for an existing one. Returns catalog information, recording constraints, questions for KPIs, and suggested next catalogs. Supports both new recordings and responding to shared requests.

catalog_id.description: ID of the catalog to start recording (required if request_id not provided)

request_id.description: ID of existing video request to continue/respond to (optional)

status.description: Indicates if the request was successful

parent_catalog_id.description: ID of parent catalog if this is a sub-catalog

catalog_id.description: ID of the catalog being used for recording

request_id.description: ID of the video request (newly created or existing)

record_date.description: Date when the recording should be made

video_types.description: Video type metrics and KPI information

metrics.description: Total number of metrics for this video type

kpis.description: Number of KPIs for this video type

video_type_id.description: ID of the associated video type

questions.description: Array of KPI-related questions for this catalog

question.example: How stressed do you feel right now?

video_question.example: Describe your current stress level in detail.

userTags.description: User's available tags for this category

next_vijo.description: Suggested catalogs for next recording session

post.summary: Submit catalog answers and video recording data
post.description: Submits answers to catalog questions, KPI metrics, and optional video thumbnail after completing a video journal recording. This endpoint processes the user's responses, stores metrics data, handles video thumbnail upload, and creates the catalog answer record.

request_id.description: ID of the video request being processed

catalog_id.description: ID of the catalog used for recording

question1_score.description: Score for KPI question 1 (required if applicable)

question2_score.description: Score for KPI question 2 (required if applicable)

question3_score.description: Score for KPI question 3 (required if applicable)

cred_score.description: Overall credibility score for the recording

n8n_executionId.description: N8N workflow execution ID for tracking

video_thumbnail_file.description: Video thumbnail image file (JPEG, PNG, etc.)

record_date.description: Recording date (defaults to current timestamp if not provided)

success.description: Indicates if the submission was successful

request_id.description: ID of the processed video request

record_date.description: Date and time when the recording was processed

404.description: Credibility score configuration not found for catalog

oneOf.example: The request id field is required.
The selected request id is invalid.
The catalog id field is required.
The selected catalog id is invalid.

items.example: The cred score must be a number.
The metric1 answer may not be greater than 50 characters.
The video thumbnail file must be a file.

get.summary: Get catalogs by category ID
get.description: Retrieves all active catalogs (non-deleted) that belong to a specific category. Returns a list of catalogs with their basic information including title, description, recording time limits, and other metadata.

parameters.name: categoryId
parameters.description: ID of the category to filter catalogs by

200.description: Catalogs by category retrieved successfully (array may be empty if none found)

data.description: Array of catalogs in the specified category (empty if none found)

description.example: A daily reflection on your thoughts and feelings

parent_catalog_id.description: Parent catalog ID if this is a sub-catalog

category_id.description: Category ID this catalog belongs to

is_promotional.description: Whether this is a promotional catalog
